    Bridge connection

    Load the bundled extension once and every open tab, its DOM buttons, and WhatsApp / Gemini / Claude / YouTube / Gmail content become live in the Tabs & Eyes view.

    1. Brave: open brave://extensions → enable Developer mode → “Load unpacked” → select extensions/ultron-browser-bridge/
    2. Firefox: open about:debugging → “This Firefox” → “Load Temporary Add-on” → select manifest.firefox.json inside the same folder
    3. The extension syncs tabs + DOM every 800 ms to POST /api/browser/sync and picks up actions on GET /api/browser/poll.
    4. Come back here — the status dot turns green within a second.
